8182.title: Status wait request amplification
8182.rootCauseOneLine: The SDK status wait repeats a complete-thread GET after each default 250 ms sleep instead of waiting for a server notification.

prReviews.topFinding: Existing open fix targets the polling mechanism; its code was not executed.

8182.proposedFix: Add a bounded, race-safe server status wait and route the SDK through it, preserving retry and timeout behavior. Existing PR #8183 already covers this work.
8182.caveats: SDK transport fixture and fake timers, repeated in two clean checkouts. No live daemon, response-size or database-cost measurements. Default zero-latency timeout yielded 4,801 GETs.
